name: DreamBench++
intro: DreamBench++ 是个性化图像生成基准：整理 150 张参考图，使用 GPT-4o 在 PartiPrompts 少样本示例和人工校准下为每图生成 9 个提示，并以静态总结规划 prefill 的一次 GPT-4o 调用分别评估概念保持和提示遵循。
build_method: 多来源图像整理, SAM 与七人质检, GPT-4o+PartiPrompts 提示生成, GPT-4o 与独立人工对齐验证
metric: GPT-4o 概念保持/提示遵循（报告 0–1，原始 0–4）；Krippendorff alpha（对齐分析）
eval_feature: 概念保持与提示遵循双维度, 静态 assistant prefill 自对齐, 每实例一次评分调用, 独立人工对齐分析
scale: 150张参考图像, 1,350个提示, 7种生成方法, 7位人工标注员
build_method_en: Multi-source Image Curation, SAM and Seven-person QC, GPT-4o+PartiPrompts Prompt Generation, Independent Human Alignment Analysis
eval_feature_en: Independent Concept-preservation and Prompt-following Ratings, Stored Assistant Prefill, One Scoring Call per Instance, Human Alignment Analysis
intro_en: DreamBench++ is a personalized-image-generation benchmark with 150 references. GPT-4o generates nine prompts per image from PartiPrompts few-shot examples followed by human calibration; a stored summary-plan assistant prefill guides one GPT-4o scoring call for independent concept-preservation and prompt-following ratings.
scale_en: 150 reference images, 1,350 prompts, 7 generation methods, 7 human annotators
metric_en: GPT-4o Concept Preservation and Prompt Following (Reported 0–1; Raw 0–4), Krippendorff's Alpha (Alignment Analysis)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with DreamBench++ arXiv:2406.16855v2 / ICLR 2025 §§2–4 and Appendix B, official repository yuangpeng/dreambench_plus@66ca27e52b5e7daa350bdb92ac8c60d4a9339c5e, Hugging Face dataset yuangpeng/dreambench_plus@459b06499fad3dac842c4b1f7a053fb3328d91c7, and data.zip upload commit d5b0c8a2a87fdae6ecf63fb18119a2e1dc67a38c. Construction starts from 200 GPT-4o keywords plus the top 200 Unsplash keywords, deduplicates and expands them with seven annotators to about 300, then gathers copyright-checked images from Unsplash, Rawpixel, Google Image Search, and authorized individual contributions. SAM removes too-small subjects; seven-person review removes noisy backgrounds/NSFW, crops and centers subjects, keeps two images per viable keyword, and manually reinforces non-photorealistic styles. The pinned core has 150 images and 150 caption files: animal 45, human 20, object 65, style 20; 120 photorealistic and 30 non-photorealistic. GPT-4o—not human authors alone—generates nine prompts per image using PartiPrompts few-shot examples, split 4/3/2 and human-calibrated, totaling 1,350. Seven methods yield 9,450 paper-run targets under the documented settings. Human-written CP/PF meta-prompts use gpt-4o-2024-05-13 at temperature 1. The pinned code performs one API call per instance with a stored summary-plan assistant prefill; it is not a dynamic two-call planning protocol. Raw 0–4 ratings are reported as mean(score)/4 on a 0–1 scale, with full/full2/full3 runs summarized by mean and standard deviation. Seven trained annotators use the same rubric independently, with GPT and human results isolated and at least two human ratings per instance. Interval Krippendorff alpha and separate Pearson analysis validate alignment; they are not per-image benchmark scores. The HF core has no train/validation/test split, while generated outputs and rating artifacts are linked through unversioned Google Drive files and therefore remain outside the pinned release boundary.
